initialize_model_parallel_groups: initialize model parallel groups with tensor, pipeline, and sequence parallel sizes for distributed training on Habana Gaudi
check_parallel_initialization: check if model parallel, sequence parallel, or data parallel groups are initialized before use
get_parallel_group: get the tensor model parallel, pipeline model parallel, data parallel, or sequence parallel process group for the current rank
get_parallel_rank_and_world_size: get the rank and world size for sequence parallel, sequence data parallel, or data parallel groups
set_training_or_eval_mode: set the training mode flag to control behavior of sequence parallel rank and world size lookups
